typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT DNCP.DONOTCALLPHONE_PHONENUMBER AS PHONENUMBER,M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER AS MEMBERNUMBER  FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CL.CALLLIST_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID 		AND CL.CALLLIST_CD = \'499\' 		AND CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE >= DATEADD(YEAR,-1,GETDATE()) 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBERPHONE MP ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID = MP.MEMBERPHONE_MEMBER_IID            	INNER JOIN PDS_DONOTCALLPHONE DNCP ON DNCP.DONOTCALLPHONE_PHONENUMBER = MP.MEMBERPHONE_PHONE 			AND DNCP.DONOTCALLPHONE_CREATE_DT >= CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE 			AND DNCP.DONOTCALLPHONE_PHONENUMBER<>\'\' 			AND DNCP.DONOTCALLPHONE_PHONENUMBER IS NOT NULL 	INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBER M ON MP.MEMBERPHONE_MEMBER_IID = M.MEMBER_IID',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> PDSDONOTCALLPHONE
PDSDONOTCALLPHONE sink(input(
		PHONENUMBER as string,
		MEMBERNUMBER as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		PHONENUMBER,
		MEMBERNUMBER)) ~> MyAdvocateDNCFile
